durationYears:3 assigned to nearly all edvoy master/PhD programs regardless of actual length; some 'MEng ... ' set to 1 year while identical 'MS ...' set to 3 — inconsistent and unsourced
language:'ru' set on English-taught US degree programs (all edvoy entries) — incorrect language metadata
Dubious/likely non-existent degrees at OSU: 'MA Computer Science', 'MA Physics', 'MA Statistics', 'MA Computer Science (Online)' — OSU does not offer MA in these fields
Scholarship amounts contradict official figures: Provost listed 'до $10,000/год' but official is up to $16,000/yr (or $6,000/yr intl); Finley listed 'до $7,500/год' but official is up to $5,000/yr
'International Excellence Scholarship' is not a verifiable named OSU/INTO award (closest official name is 'Provost's Scholarship for Excellence')

evidence: Official program-prices page (admissions.oregonstate.edu/international/prices-scholarships/program-prices, 2025-26) confirms catalog tuition EXACTLY: IYO/UTP 3-term=$41,110, Graduate Pathway 3-term=$36,500, Pathway MBA 3-term=$48,240, Academic English=$6,800, Direct-Entry MBA=$47,810 (catalog mba=47810). Campuses verified via oregonstate.edu/about: Corvallis main, OSU-Cascades (Bend), Hatfield Marine Science Center (Newport), OSU Portland Center — all 4 match.
